page.overview:
Who is Beret Boy?

The Beret Boy lives in Hytopia. He likes Mimi and can often be found playing with her. He mentions that she seems more preoccupied with finding blue birds and the Drablands Diary.

She may sometimes lend volume 6 of the diary to him, which he will then read to a cat laying on a bench. After Link lifts the curse off of Princess Styla, he can be found talking with Mimi.

The Beret Boy is disappointed that Mimi always ignores him, and says if she wants to find something blue, she should look at him. Mimi agrees to this and asks him never to leave her, which makes the Beret Boy very happy.
